headline: Updates you can watch, and Spotify that keeps playing

items.title: Updates you can follow
items.text: The app shows an update step by step, from the download to the install, and it keeps going if the app closes or the connection drops.

items.title: Spotify rides out a dropped connection
items.text: When Spotify's servers drop the connection, playback carries on, and the volume stays where you left it.

items.title: Spotify and AirPlay pick up an update
items.text: After an update, Spotify and AirPlay switch to the new version as soon as nothing is playing, with no restart of the Q.
